tests/categories.e2e.ts › categories page › duplicate category name is rejected with inline error

behaviors_proved: Initial render shows all seeded categories including a row tagged data-testid='category-uncategorized'.
Uncategorized row has zero category-delete-btn descendants (cannot be deleted) while still exposing edit.
Add category form appends a new row on successful submit.
Duplicate name (case-insensitive) surfaces new-category-error and does not add a row.
Inline edit renames a category in place and dismisses the edit form on save.

Delete cascades reassign expenses to Uncategorized, surface cascade-notice with 'moved to Uncategorized' text, and the affected expense row reflects the new category on the dashboard after navigation.
